changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE daily_rule ( rule_id INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, user_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, task_type VARCHAR(40) REFERENCES task_type(name), priority VARCHAR(20), impact VARCHAR(20), color VARCHAR(20), blocked BOOLEAN, max_per_day INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE INDEX idx_daily_rule_user ON daily_rule(user_id); CREATE TABLE daily_rule_tag ( rule_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES daily_rule(rule_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, tag_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tag(tag_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY (rule_id, tag_id) );
